goal: Interview conversion for FAANG / high-paying product-company interviews; retention and pattern retrieval over raw problem count.
curriculumStrategy: Curated union/overlap of NeetCode 150, Blind 75, LeetCode Top Interview 150, then company-targeted reinforcement. Lists are not completed independently.
sundayRule: No mandatory new problems. Spaced re-solving, error-log review, weak-topic repair, and one timed mock.

weeks.focus: Arrays, Hashing, Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Prefix Sum
Binary Search, Linked Lists, Stack, Monotonic Stack
Trees, BST, DFS, BFS, Recursive Invariants
Graphs, BFS/DFS, Union Find, Topological Sort, Shortest Path, MST
Mixed Interview Set + High-Yield Design/Data-Structure Problems
Timed Mixed Problems, Selected Hards, Weak-Topic Repair
